title: Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition (ResNet)
summary: Kaiming He, Xiangyu Zhang, Shaoqing Ren and Jian Sun submitted Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition on December 10, 2015. The paper presents a residual learning framework that reformulates layers as learning residual functions with reference to layer inputs and reports experiments with residual networks up to 152 layers on ImageNet.
significance: A documented deep-learning architecture milestone introducing the residual-learning framework later published at CVPR 2016.

verification.note: Title, authors, December 10 2015 submission date, residual-learning formulation and reported 152-layer ImageNet experiments are supported by the original arXiv record. The Computer Vision Foundation's CVPR 2016 record independently corroborates the authors, paper, framework and later conference publication.
